article.intro: Natural honey is one of the oldest and greatest nutritional and therapeutic treasures known to humanity. At Kounouz Alafiya, we harvest honey using the most modern scientific methods, ensuring that active enzymes and amino acids remain intact, with no heat treatment that could harm its quality.
article.tipsTitle: Key tips to get the most out of it:

tips.morningSpoon: Take a spoonful in the morning on an empty stomach, dissolved in lukewarm water, for faster absorption.
tips.woodenSpoon: Use wooden or ceramic spoons and avoid metal ones to preserve the enzymatic properties.
tips.storage: Store honey at room temperature (20-25°C), away from direct sunlight.

verified.a: A sealed sample of the batch was tested by an accredited lab, then the Kounouz verification team approved the results. Only verified batches are put on sale.

whereQr.q: Where do I find the verification code?
whereQr.a: On the jar label: a QR code with a written code underneath (e.g. KZ-QR-2026-000001). Scan the QR with your phone camera, or type the code into the verification field above.

problem.q: What if the product shows “suspended” or the code isn’t found?
problem.a: Don’t consume the product before contacting us: it may be temporarily suspended, or the label may be counterfeit. You can report a suspicious label from the verification page; the report goes to our anti-counterfeit team.

prices.a: Yes, all prices are shown in Tunisian dinars (TND). The price of each size appears when you choose the product.

producer.q: I’m a beekeeper — how do I sell my honey on Kounouz?
producer.a: Create a producer account and submit a verification request. Our team reviews it and arranges sampling (an agent visit or you drop it off), then the lab analysis. Once verified, your honey is packaged and listed in the shop.
